test_cases.summary:

when network latency occurs

Feature: Session Label Dropdown Performance
Scenario: Loading indicator shown during delay

test_cases.acceptance:
A loading spinner or indicator should be displayed until data loads
The behavior should be validated when the dropdown is opened.
